B1.caveat: sign is NOT stable across the wait parameter: a prototype sweep gave +13.3% at 30 min, +20.0% at 50 and 60 min, and -15.2% at 90 min. 50 min was fixed in advance from a live diagnosis, not chosen from this sweep -- this mask evaluates that fixed choice, it does not search for a better one.
B1.method: real market reopens measured off the M15 bar stream (session_clock.market_reopens, gap >= 60 min with no bar); blocks positions opened < 50 min after a reopen
B1.verdict: NO VETO -- the gap-wait gate was not catastrophic over the 7-month substrate

B2.method: positions entered inside +/-30 min of a calendar event, over the covered range only

B3.expected: ZERO drops -- the cap IS the observed peak, so it never bit
B3.method: chronological greedy replay against the observed-peak cap

B4.method: the position CSVs carry no SL column; reconstructing it means re-simulating (out of scope)
B4.verdict: NOT MASKABLE -- B4 is a live BUG DETECTOR, not a filter
